The Best K-Beauty Gifts Under $25, Including Hudson Williams' Skincare Pick

 From viral skincare kits to glossy lip tints and glittery makeup, these Korean beauty gifts start at $9 and all cost less than $25.
 By Sofía Viera Oct 28, 2026 9:00 PM Tags Shopping Shop Beauty Gifts Under 50 E! Insider Shop Holiday Gift Guide Gifts by Interest E! Insider Skincare Holiday Gifts by Interest Link Copied Add E! News to Google Courtesy of SKIN1004 If you're thinking of gifting skincare or makeup , your best option if you want bang for your buck is Korean beauty. While this isn't anything new, K-Beauty has gone especially viral this year —with new brands and products added to major US retailers like iHerb, Amazon, Sephora, and Ulta Beauty. 
 From cleansers and serums to mascaras and lip tints , these Korean products are formulated nearly to perfection for a truly affordable price. Not even drugstore American beauty compares to the excellence K-Beauty has to offer. And all of these are under $25 and so viral right now. We'd recommend stocking up now before they sell out!
 So, whether you have a person in your life who is a total K-Beauty pro or merely curious, keep scrolling to shop the best products and brands to get as gifts this holiday season (starting at just $9, and all for under $25) . 
 Best K-Beauty Set for  Heated Rivalry  and Skincare Lovers: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Travel Kit 
 Best K-Beauty Gift for The Retinol-Curious: Celimax Retinal Shot Tightening Booster 
 Best K-Makeup to Gift for a Whole Shimmering Look: Unleashia Glitterpedia Eyeshadow Palette 
 Gift This Viral K-Beauty Blurred Lips & Water Tints Trend: ETUDE Dear Darling Water Tint 
 Shop K-Beauty Skincare Gifts:
 SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Travel Kit
 If your bestie loves Korean skincare and  Heated Rivalry,  this brand (whose ambassador is Hudson Williams) has a perfect gift set for them. Infused with Centella Asiatica extract, this travel kit includes the cleansing oil, ampoule foam, toner, ampoule, and cream. 
 $22.07 $25.97 iHerb $18.90 $26 Amazon $21 $30 Ulta Beauty $26 Nordstrom Celimax Retinal Shot Tightening Booster
 Celebrity- and editor-loved, this retinol booster features 0.1% retinal, 3% matrixyl, niacinamide, and 1% panthenol to tighten, firm, brighten, and stimulate collagen production. Plus, the formula is gentle enough for first-time Retinol users. 
 $20.40 $24 iHerb $18.60 $24 Amazon $24 Ulta Beauty Editor's Pick Biodance Bio Collagen Real Deep Beauty Masks
 The Biodance Collagen Mask is one of the best affordable prestige sheet masks you could get. It's formulated with collagen to minimize the look of pores and improve elasticity and texture.
 $19 iHerb $19 Amazon $19 Sephora Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Refreshing Pore Beauty Mask
 Prefer a wash-off mask instead? This one by Beauty of Joseon is infused with Haenam Red Bean extract and kaolin to soften dead skin cells, purify pores, and absorb excess oil without stripping moisture from your skin. 
 $16.80 iHerb $16 $19.99 Amazon $20 Sephora Editor's Pick Dr. Althea 345 Relief Cream
 This moisturizer is formulated to care for and soothe the skin after breakouts. The formula blends three blemish-care, four hydrating, and five soothing ingredients in a lightweight, gel-like texture that instantly gets absorbed (and won't clog your pores).

 TIRTIR Mask Fit Red Cushion
 This cushion foundation is viral for a reason. It delivers medium-to-full coverage with a totally weightless feel, and it promises to stay flawless for up to 72 hours without a single touch-up. 
 $20.91 iHerb $19.99 $25 Amazon $25 Ulta Beauty $15 (mini) Nordstrom ETUDE Dear Darling Water Tint
 Lip stains and water tints are extremely trendy right now. And this ETUDE one is a fan favorite, with its kiss-and-smudge-proof formula that's absorbed quickly and gives you a wash of color that won't get sticky. 
 $9.99 iHerb $9.99 Amazon $9.99 Ulta Beauty Unleashia Glitterpedia Eyeshadow Palette
 Infused with multidimensional glitter particles for that coveted 3D shine, this K-Beauty eyeshadow palette features a mix of matte, shimmer, and glitter finishes with a soft formula that blends like a dream and leaves minimal fallout. 
 $13.89 $16.34 iHerb $23.99 Amazon $16.80 $24 Ulta Beauty Petitfee Super Volume Lip Oil
 This lip oil has a non-sticky, glossy texture that promises to boost volume and shine with its formula full of almond, hazelnut seed, jojoba, macadamia, and sunflower oils, as well as daisy extract, rosehip berry, marigold, and rose extracts.  
 $11.53 iHerb $14 Amazon Heimish Dailism Smudge Stop Mascara
 This tubing mascara has a clump-free and smudge-proof formula that promises to lift, define, lengthen, and curl your eyelashes.
